name: conflict-notifications
description: Notifications triggered by a conflicting update (2026-11-16). A conflict notification set on one survey fires only for conflicts made by saving that survey; one set on the bundle fires for a conflict made by saving any of its surveys. The workflow page shows each as a conflict trigger named after its survey or bundle (not the notification), carrying the notification so it can be edited, leading to an email step that shows its subject and recipients; a bundle conflict notification is not drawn as fired by the bundle's forms. Each notification loads in the workflow edit drawer; a bundle notification did not, as the edit, save and delete queries only allowed project and survey notifications. Uses the update-conflicts surveys. The notifications send to the record's a_note question, whose answers are not email addresses, so no email is sent; they are kept on the surveys and also fire, sending nothing, during the update-conflicts test. Each run adds two records to the update-conflicts surveys.

scenarios.name: stage-2-save
scenarios.description: Stage 2 is saved from a version stage 1 has since changed, so the conflict is made by a stage 2 save.

scenarios.name: stage-1-save
scenarios.description: Stage 1 is saved from a version stage 2 has since changed, so the conflict is made by a stage 1 save.
